source.name: Customer Inventory Management
source.publisher: Myron Yazılım Ve Danışmanlık Hizmetleri Anonim Şirketi

mapping.summary: Tracks consignment inventory at customer sites
claims: Tracks consignment stock at customer sites separately from own warehouse stock
Logs stock receipts, returns and transfers as movements for customer-owned inventory
Serial number tracking with location and bin control for customer inventory
Transfers customer inventory between warehouses or marks it delivered/returned
Shipments linked to sales orders marked Customer Inventory are tracked automatically
Works with warehouse shipments as well as sales orders
Order, recipient, document and posting date traceability in customer inventory ledger entries
Excel export and Customer Inventory Transactions report
